messages:
alex.kim: Heads-up — ACME POC is at contract review and they want a 35% introductory discount for the first year. CPQ throws an error if discount >20%. Need routing for an expedited exception. Can Deal Desk triage? :pray: 

priya.patel: @alex.kim thanks for flagging. Can you confirm ARR and committed term? also any technical blockers we should log?

alex.kim: ARR ~ $120k/year. Customer will commit 12 months, potential to expand into Dedicated next year. No technical blockers — infra ok. They asked for an SLA and private tenancy discussion but that can follow.

marco.ramos: 35% is out of band. If this is a short-term POC convert to a trial credit + onboarding discount, we can keep list discount <=20% and apply onboarding rebate in the SOW. That avoids changing CPQ rules.

nina.hart: +1 to Marco. If AE insists on 35% now, Deal Desk needs approval path and a pricing justification (growth motion + logo). Otherwise propose: 20% list discount in CPQ + $10k onboarding rebate (paper).

alex.kim: Customer wants the discount shown on the quote line item (they're sensitive to sticker). Rebate in SOW won't fly — they need to show unit price in procurement docs.

priya.patel: Understood. That's the key ask. Two options: (1) Escalate to Pricing Ops for temporary approval (fast-path SLA 48h) with documented exec sponsor & referenceable case. (2) If true enterprise commitment (>=12 months & capex), escalate to VP Sales for one-off. Which do you have, Alex?

alex.kim: They've signed the LOI verbally and will commit 12 months, but legal needs the number on the quote now. I can get an exec sponsor note by EOD. Need to know what fields to populate in SF so CPQ will allow override.

priya.patel: Copy this mapping into the quote and attach the exec sponsor email: ```
Pricing_Override__c: true
Override_Approver__c: priya.patel
Override_Reason__c: Strategic logo / POC -> Dedicated
Override_Expiry__c: 2024-12-31
Requested_Discount__c: 35
```

dealdesk-bot: Ticket #DD-2026-182 created. SLA: 48 hours for Pricing Ops review. Attachments: quote PDF, LOI email, exec sponsor.

samuel.lee: From Legal: if discount >25% we need a pricing carveout clause + explicit audit rights for billing. I'll draft the clause once I see the quote. Please cc me on the sponsor email.

marco.ramos: I'll take the Pricing Ops review. Alex — upload the quote and exec note to the DD ticket and set `Approval_Status__c` to `pending_pricing_ops` in SF. If we approve, I'll push an override token that CPQ will accept.

alex.kim: Uploading now. Also adding comment to the SF quote: `Approval_Status__c=pending_pricing_ops; Approval_Priority__c=expedite`. Ping me if you need anything else. :thumbsup:

priya.patel: Workflow note for the runbook: expedited pricing exceptions require (1) exec sponsor email, (2) revenue commit >= 12 months, (3) legal carveout ack, (4) pricing ops ticket. If any item missing -> reject and offer rebate alternative. I'll update the deal desk template in SF today.

nina.hart: Thanks — can we also add a checkbox `Show_Discount_On_QT__c` so finance knows when to expose net price to buyer? That prevents accidental exposure on other quotes.

marco.ramos: Good call. I'll include that field in the override flow and add a note to the token that it's valid for first invoice only.

alex.kim: Everyone — really appreciate the quick turnaround. Will ping once sponsor email is in DD ticket.

dealdesk-bot: DD-2026-182 status updated -> `awaiting_pricing_ops_review`. SLA countdown started (48h).
